text: Medications for anxiety/ADHD may help as part of a comprehensive plan. The decision should be made with a specialist mental-health professional—it is not a decision to be made alone.

review_defects.why: The Arabic specifies a specialist psychiatrist (a medical doctor), while the English broadens the term to any mental-health professional, which could include non-medical practitioners. This dilutes the intended emphasis on medical oversight for medication decisions.
